captures.state: Audio help after actual sound-test request
captures.title: Audio Help · NATO Phonetics
captures.text:
Audio Help
Test your audio
The test plays Alfa, Bravo, then the radio pronunciations for 3, 5 and 9. Compare the digits with TREE, FIFE and NIN-er.
Play audio test
If you cannot hear speech
Check media volume, connected headphones and Bluetooth audio. On a physical iPhone, turn off silent mode. Try System Default or another installed English voice. Install voices using your device speech settings, then retry the voice list.
Choose a voice
Playback and privacy
Starting another card, phrase, quiz answer or preview replaces the current audio. Stop, leaving the screen, editing converter text or backgrounding the app cancels the remaining words and pauses. If a provider does not finish, playback times out with a retry message.
Audio uses your device or browser speech provider. Some voices need a network connection. The app does not verify where a provider processes text, guarantee offline speech, or request microphone access for playback. Pronunciation varies by voice; the written guide remains available.
Privacy Policy
